text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks a bunch! Thanks to the day off
you gave me, I got to indulge myself a little.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Believe it or not!
............I went back to sleep a third time!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Plus, spending the whole day in pajamas—talk about living like a celebrity!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my skin's looking a bit nicer.
...Compared to my usual self, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And with that, keep your hopes up for Nature-san!
Just kidding~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Nice Nature
got plenty of rest!
